in_marathi.name: Asik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Asik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'asau' meaning 'dawn' or 'early morning light'. This name is often associated with the Hindu god Surya, the deity of the sun.
